loss: Mean per-channel squared current error normalized by fit-role channel max(abs(current)), floor1e-7, plus0.1*mean opening squared error. All ensemble members use identical minibatch/start indices. Independent parameters and per-member clipping. No teacher forcing of latent state within chunks.
architecture: Family-blocked recurrent latent state, sigmoid convex update and sigmoid opening readout; shared V/logCa trunk. Initial family encoder sees only its own physical gates once at chunk/restart. V,Ca remain explicit. No canonical rates, teacher gates or gate decoder during recurrence. Current uses cheap canonical gbar*opening*(V-E). P unchanged and used as comparator, not as training target.
selection: Per arm/seed choose checkpoint by development mean normalized current MSE on fixed256tick segments starting at0,150,275ms, before/around rest. Save all checkpoints; ties earliest. Freeze before accessing fresh-role evaluations. No fresh selection or threshold adjustment.
evaluation: Canonical initial physical states encoded once; same V/Ca future for candidates, P and canonical64. Full-prefix unchanged current NRMSE/NMAX/charge gates, openings and drift diagnostics; reset-latent negative control at100ms on pulse_recovery. No membrane/coupled-system or event-timing release. Report all arms/seeds, no averaging to waive failed cases.

cost.scope: Resident current-step latency at same batch, V/Ca/state, eager GPU. Compare compact recurrence+readout, frozenP+readout and canonical64+readout. Initial encoding cost separate; no whole-neuron speedup claim.

hypotheses.claim: More latent coordinates preserve slow memory better than five coordinates.
hypotheses.contrast: L5_T16 versusL10_T16 versusL18_T16 at matched optimizer/minibatches.

hypotheses.claim: Trunk capacity limits learning separately from state capacity.
Observed errors can be training-budget limited rather than irreducible compression loss.
hypotheses.contrast: 250/1000/2000 checkpoints along same trajectories, development only selection.

hypotheses.claim: Learned latent state carries causal memory, not only an instantaneous V/Ca mapping.
hypotheses.contrast: Reset latent at100ms versus intact recurrence on the same pulse/recovery trajectory.

limitations: P retains47 and49 failures. Physical initial gates are a privileged state-available contract, not a voltage-only initializer. No assertion of minimal state, full-neuron equivalence or coupled speedup. Task49 PCA failure does not imply nonlinear learned compression impossibility.
